Messages.Author: Peter Muto
Messages.Body:
Is WW EVER going to post an exact list of what's in the FN precon's?
This seems especially relevant since they've run out of SW starters
and all future sealed tournaments would basically have to be based off
the FN starters. Seems silly that I still can't just snag a complete
list off the website.

Peter Muto
VEKN Prince of Toronto
